verdict.rationale: Exporting all user data in open formats to leave the platform is a fair question for an operating system, but the evidence pack does not document it. The migration evidence covers moving data into a Mac from a PC, and AirDrop and Continuity only move files between Apple devices. Single-file conversions such as combining files into a PDF or qlmanage's SVG-to-PNG are adjacent features, not a full data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
